response.justification: Bogdan possesses an exceptionally strong background in software and infrastructure engineering, significantly exceeding the 15-year experience requirement. His recent work on AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling is highly relevant to the role's AI focus, and his entrepreneurial and teaching experience demonstrates leadership and the ability to inspire, making him a strong candidate despite not holding a Master's degree or explicitly having a 'Director-level' title.
strengths: Over 18 years of diverse and deep software and infrastructure engineering experience.
Direct and recent experience with AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling.
Strong full-stack capabilities, cloud expertise (AWS, Kubernetes), and a focus on software craftsmanship.
concerns: Lacks a Master's or PhD degree in an AI-related field, a preferred qualification.
While strong in AI infrastructure, the resume doesn't explicitly detail 'recognized expertise in AI with demonstrated products or platforms built with AI' across his career.
No explicit 'Director-level' title or dedicated role focused purely on high-level AI product strategy.

key_factors.factor: Lack of Advanced AI Degree/Explicit AI Product Leadership
